item.text: I’ll implement this through the CSSStyleDeclaration API so only the `height` declaration is changed, preserving all other inline style declarations. The unit check will be case insensitive and target `vh` occurrences in that property’s value.
The helper and pipeline call are in place. The focused Jest test is running now; it covers lowercase and uppercase `vh`, preservation of unrelated styles, and elements without a height declaration.

The focused test caught a browser CSS parser behavior: JSDOM drops the invalid uppercase `20VH` declaration before the helper can inspect it. I’m adjusting the implementation to inspect the raw `height` declaration text, which also matches the requirement to examine inline style values directly.

Implemented `transformStyleAttributes` to replace inline `height` values containing `vh` with `auto`, preserving other styles. It runs after `transformStylesheet` and before `transformRemote`.

The focused test passed: `yarn workspace proton-mail test --runInBand src/app/helpers/transforms/tests/transformStyleAttributes.test.ts`.
